Glance 2026.08.06.1 adds verified in-app updates with automatic installation and restart.

## Highlights

- Check for updates, download the installer, and complete an upgrade without leaving Glance settings.
- Follow download progress through a Fluent progress card and cancel before installation begins.
- Verify downloaded installers against the SHA-256 digest published by GitHub before execution.
- Preserve previously selected optional components during upgrades and select newly introduced components by default.
- Prioritize direct installation for installed builds and the Release page for portable builds while keeping both actions available.
- Restart Glance automatically under the original user account after a successful update.

## Release contents

- `Glance-Setup-2026.08.06.1-x64.exe`: Recommended installer containing the core application and selectable optional components. All components are selected by default on a new installation.
- `Glance-2026.08.06.1-x64.zip`: Portable core application without optional components.
- `Glance-Component-<Name>-2026.08.06.1-x64.zip`: Standalone optional component. Use only the package from the same Glance release, extract it into the application's `components` directory, and restart Glance.
- `Glance-2026.08.06.1-x64-symbols.zip`: Debug symbols for diagnostics and crash analysis.
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`: SHA-256 checksums for every release asset.
